fields.description: The step this person takes. Stored by the step's key, so renaming a step does not detach who takes it; the list shows the step's current name.

fields.label: Stage name
fields.description: The step's name as of the last save -- kept for exports and older readers. The key in Stage is what counts.

fields.label: Farm
fields.description: Leave empty to let this person act on every farm. Only the farm-scoped stages read it.

fields.label: Role override
fields.description: Leave empty to use the stage's role. Set it to keep one farm's approvals separate from another's — a per-farm role is what stops any farm manager approving every farm.
